svg.text: Can Lansing renters afford basic needs? By household composition
Each chart shows that composition's own income distribution. Red = below income needed for housing and basic needs. Black = above.
Income distributions from ACS PUMS 2024 1-year (PUMA 01801, Lansing area), scaled to City of Lansing composition totals (B25115). Thresholds: residual-income method.
